profile.headline: Platform Software Engineer | Customer Success Software Engineer | Project Manager
profile.summary:
Leveraging a diverse background as a Software Engineer and Application Project Manager, my skills are focused on the development, implementation, and maintenance of software applications and cloud server management. Proficient in ensuring optimal performance and delivering robust support across various digital initiatives. Specialized in managing and executing projects within the full stack development lifecycle  and overall technical support.
Active CAC | Tier 1 NACI Favorable | Clearable for Public Trust & Secret

positions.title: Solutions Software Engineer - Customer Success
positions.description:
Technical Incident & SLA Management: Manage critical path resolution for global enterprise clients, utilizing Azure Log Analytics and SQL to trace error flows across APIs/middleware, ensuring strict SLA adherence.

Engineering & Solution Delivery: Develop and deploy rapid-response patches and database fixes to resolve complex platform bottlenecks; architect custom SaaS integrations to expand client system capabilities.

AI Management & Security: Proficient on Agentic framework, AI Management & Security; familiarity of AI & ML models.

Cross-Functional Product Leadership: Serve as the primary technical liaison between TAMs, Product, and Core Engineering; proven ability to lead technical engagements (e.g., hackathons, PoCs, MVPs) that drive production-scale outcomes.

Client Environment Optimization: Orchestrate full-cycle client environment upgrades and performance tuning; lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) meetings with client leadership to restore confidence and ensure long-term stability.

[Government Clearance]

positions.title: Software Engineer | Web Operations Manager
positions.description:
• As Marketing Department Software Engineer & Web Operations Manager, I collaborated with cross-functional teams to develop, and maintain software applications, including 
  coding, scripting, testing, debugging, and deployment necessary to solve technical support issues 
• Integrated application features, designed content pages, executed website migrations, cloud app 
  deployment pipeline configurations, hosting, and database optimizations, including platform 
  integration scripting; reduced bounce rate, improved lead conversion, and  optimized 
   server & web performance
• Orchestrated data migration and cutover strategies, ensuring zero downtime; reduced post-migration issues 
• Generated strategic website planning, roadmaps, and training documentation to align with  
  organizational goals
• Created architecture diagramming to provide clear and concise visual representations of complex 
   technical systems and processes; Elevated internal processes and workflows, resulting in  
   increased team productivity
•  Executed cyber risk assessments, penetration testing, and performance-tuning to mitigate potential 
    security threats; reached 100% percent security compliance; Spearheaded consent compliance (CCPA, 
    CPRA, GDPR)
•  Generated process and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation, facilitating identifying and 
    mitigating key issues to enhance operational efficiency; Supervised QA testing and UAT
•  Maintained and administered program configurations for email and CRM automation, resulting in increased conversion rates
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Project Management · Office 365 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · .NET Framework · Web Development · Angular · WordPress · PHP · Node.js · Analytics · Ticketing Systems · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · JavaScript · Technical Support · Support Documentation · GitHub · Figma (Software)

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
Template integration utilizing Vanilla JS, jQuery, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML, SQL 
•	Engineered responsive design to ensure 100% cross-platform compatibility and overall user experience
•	Ensured quality code and UI/UX to enforce consistency across all assets, devices, platforms, and email clients. 
•	Optimized template library 
•	Delivered outstanding technical support by anticipating and fulfilling stakeholder requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Office 365 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft Office · Node.js · JavaScript · Technical Support · Support Documentation · GitHub · HTML5

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered features for the minimal viable product (MVP) that tracks walking habits for  Dog Lovers.
•	Developed features and profiles:  frontend and backend implementation, modal, database design and queries, unit testing, email integration SendGrid
•	Coordinated with the development team throughout the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) utilizing peer planning sessions, code reviews, paired programming, source control process, and testing
•	Utilized a wide range of technologies and tools, including React, ASP.NET Web API, SQL, TFS, Trello, and Azure to deliver efficient and effective software solutions
•	Consolidated, tracked, and resolved case histories and application issues for a more thorough project knowledge base
•	Conducted QA testing and user acceptance testing for application bugs in collaboration with developers and other stakeholders
positions.insights: Skills: Office 365 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · .NET Framework · Node.js · Firebase · Powershell · React.js · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · GitHub · Adobe Photoshop · ASP.NET Web API · HTML5

positions.title: Professional development
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description:
Transitioned from enterprise telecommunications to formalize a career shift into software engineering, driven by early independent contract projects in web development and digital marketing. Completed an intensive, full-time curriculum at Sabio Los Angeles to solidify full-stack architecture skills, seamlessly bridging prior network infrastructure expertise with programmatic logic. (Early independent contract details available upon request).

Full-Stack Application Development: Engineered robust web applications utilizing C# / .NET, JavaScript, and relational database management.

Case Study Architecture & API Integration: Designed and deployed comprehensive case studies, integrating secure RESTful APIs with responsive front-end frameworks.

Agile Workflows & Version Control: Managed project lifecycles within Agile/Scrum environments using Git/GitHub, adhering to strict Clean Code standards.

Systems Logic & Infrastructure Alignment: Mapped complex business requirements to scalable software architectures, leveraging foundational enterprise networking experience.

positions.title: Account Development Executive- P2P IP Network Services
positions.description:
Technical Sales & Infrastructure Alignment: Directed technical sales cycles for Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), point-to-point (P2P) Fixed Wireless networks, and Unified Communications, aligning cloud and managed services with Enterprise and Mid-Market infrastructure requirements.

Executive Engagement & Complex Deal Execution: Cultivated strategic relationships with C-suite executives and IT decision-makers, navigating complex procurement workflows to close high-value, multi-site network and IP service contracts.

Cross-Functional Solution Engineering: Collaborated extensively with Network Engineering and Professional Services teams to scope technical requirements, validate network topologies, and deliver customized deployment proposals.

Channel Management & Business Development: Leveraged IT vendor partnerships and managed Channel Partner ecosystems to architect comprehensive networking solutions, driving new business acquisition while ensuring post-deployment account retention.

Technical Presentations & Pipeline Operations: Led comprehensive client-facing technical presentations and evangelized service capabilities at industry events. Managed territory forecasting, partner engagements, and account lifecycles utilizing Salesforce and cloud CRM tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Sales Operations · Leadership · Microsoft Office · Strategic Partnerships

positions.title: Account Manager > Account Executive - Fiber , Cloud, IP Services
positions.description:
Consultative Telecom & Cloud Solutions: Partner with enterprise organizations across the Entertainment, Media, and Hospitality verticals to architect high-capacity fiber optic, Ethernet, and cloud-native solutions that optimize network infrastructure, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Pipeline Infrastructure & Strategic Account Mapping: Manage a complex enterprise business pipeline utilizing Salesforce, analyzing deployment metrics and territory infrastructure data to execute long-term strategies for sustained revenue growth.

Cross-Functional Solution Engineering: Collaborate directly with Solution Architects and network engineering teams to review technical specifications, validate design feasibility, and present comprehensive technical proposals to stakeholder decision-makers.

Strategic Partner Advocacy & Field Engagement: Drive adoption of enterprise-grade communication systems and transport services through technical consultation, direct in-person executive engagement, and industry-specific networking events.
positions.insights: Skills: Sales Operations · Network Administration · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Office · Strategic Partnerships

positions.title: Regional Account Manager
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Target-Driven Infrastructure Sales: Served as a trusted enterprise advisor, consistently hitting revenue goals by delivering complex dark/lit fiber optics, high-density colocation, and carrier-grade Ethernet solutions.

Technical Business Development: Spearheaded regional pipeline growth, translating intricate network topologies and data center floor requirements into scalable client solutions within a fast-paced environment.

Cross-Functional Architecture Delivery: Partnered closely with engineering, provisioning, and product teams to map client technical specs to physical infrastructure, ensuring accurate deployment and high retention.

C-Suite Negotiations: Executed data-driven presentations and multi-year contract negotiations with C-level stakeholders, leveraging CRM data to forecast revenue and optimize the sales cycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Enterprise Account Management · Fiber Optic Networks · Wide Area Network (WAN) · Colocation Facilities

positions.title: Technical Sales Operations Manager | Process Improvement Lead
positions.description:
Fast-Tracked from technical software sales to management within a high-growth cybersecurity startup. Directed operations for a division of nearly 100 personnel, optimizing remote PC security and software repair services. Drove scalable process improvements and sustained business continuity through a corporate acquisition.

Key Responsibilities & Impact
Operational Leadership: Managed daily technical operations and workforce analytics for ~100 staff, optimizing resource allocation to consistently hit aggressive quota targets.
Process Engineering (CI): Overhauled Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for incident resolution, boosting workflow efficiency, compliance, and organizational scalability.

Data-Driven Strategy: Translated customer feedback and diagnostic data into actionable business requirements to guide new security support protocols and maximize ROI.

Change Management: Steered the division through hyper-growth and a corporate acquisition, maintaining operational stability and team alignment.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Sales Operations · Management · Executive Support · Strategic Planning · IT & Business Strategy Alignment
